labels.text: Tigray War: Amharan Special Forces withdraw from the Tigray Region in line with an African Union-backed peace agreement between the Ethiopian government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front.
Tigray War: Eritrean forces withdraw from Shire and other major towns in the Tigray Region of Ethiopia.
Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates become BRICS members.
Ethiopia announces an agreement with Somaliland to use the port of Berbera. Ethiopia also says that it will eventually recognize Somaliland's independence, becoming the first country to do so.
Landslides kill 257 people and bury two villages in Geze Gofa, Gofa Zuria, Ethiopia.
A truck carrying passengers falls off a bridge over the Ganale Doria River in Bona Zuria, Sidama Region, Ethiopia, killing 71 people and injuring 4 others.
Ethiopian civil conflict: Clashes erupt in the Tigray region in Ethiopia between Tigrayan fighters and Federal Forces.
2026 Ethiopian general election: The Prosperity Party, led by incumbent Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, wins reelection.

2026 Ethiopian offensive: The Tigray People’s Liberation Front and groups aligned with them launch a military offensive in northern Ethiopia against the Ethiopian Government, resuming the civil conflict.
